items.title: Hypolite Charles Interview, 1963-04-13
items.q: Oh yeah, that's Mr. Bienvenue from the New Orleans Country Club. He was going to put me over there

ctx.x: Oh yeah, that's Mr. Bienvenue from the New Orleans Country Club. He was going to put me over there, the first one was going on the app in New Orleans, WSMB. But I got sick, that's the time I got sick. I was working for New Orleans Country Club. I had my horn band. I got my little sign yet that I used to put in front of music stands.
